scripts.dev:server: bun run build:deps && bun run --filter @tabliodb/server dev:only
scripts.build: bun run build:deps && bun run --filter @tabliodb/server build:only && bun run --filter @tabliodb/web build
scripts.build:deps: bun run --filter @tabliodb/shared build && bun run --filter @tabliodb/schema-core build && bun run --filter @tabliodb/sql build && bun run --filter @tabliodb/docs build && bun run --filter @tabliodb/render build && bun run --filter @tabliodb/ui build && bun run --filter @tabliodb/sdk build
scripts.test:unit: bun run --filter './packages/*' test && bun run --filter @tabliodb/server test && bun run --filter @tabliodb/web test
scripts.docker:prod:logs: docker compose --env-file docker/production.env -f docker/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f tabliodb
scripts.sdk:generate: bun run openapi:sync && bunx oazapfts --optimistic --argumentStyle=object --useEnumType --allSchemas open-api/tabliodb-openapi-specs.json packages/sdk/src/fetch-client.ts && bunx prettier --write packages/sdk/src/fetch-client.ts
